name: amda-skill
description: Frameworks for enterprise AI go-to-market, packaged as installable agent skills. Decision governance and pilot production-readiness.

plugins.name: amda-decision-router
plugins.description: Four skills, one per framework. amda-decision-router sorts decisions into three AI governance zones by reversibility, exposure and frequency. pilot-trap-auditor places a pilot on a five-stage arc and names which of six infrastructure gaps are open. trust-architecture-diagnostic finds which of three trust layers is blocking a deal. belief-bridge-builder audits a pitch for four planks and names the missing one. 74 labelled evaluation cases across the four.
